display_long_description:
Umbrawl pits you against other shadow beings in the Umbral Plane. Customize your shadow character, and enter the Umbral Forest to fight other shadow beings and claim the crown. 

Utilizes a completely unique hand walking and flying locomotion.

[media]

Join a random lobby, or create a custom lobby to play with friends. Set your custom lobby to "open" so random players can join your forest.

[media]

Buttons:
- Hold A or X and reach your hands out to fly.
- Triggers to shoot.
- Grip button to grab and use menus.

[media]

Why early access?

We want to test Umbrawl in a real-player setting to make sure there are no unfun bugs. We also want to see your responses and feedback. We do not plan on staying in early access for long.
